create_ConvTBC_module: create a ConvTBC module with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size for 1D convolution
build_ConvTBC_with_padding: build a ConvTBC convolutional layer with custom padding for time-batch-channel tensor input
run_ConvTBC_forward: run the ConvTBC forward pass on a time-batch-channel shaped input tensor
reset_ConvTBC_parameters: reset the ConvTBC weight and bias parameters using Xavier normal and zero initialization
review_ConvTBC_conv_tbc: review the ConvTBC conv_tbc method that performs GEMM-based 1D convolution on contiguous tensors
